title: Astro Portal target texts shard
description: One shard file of the catalogue texts: `target-library/texts/<locale>/<shard>.json` of the static-data package (docs/STATIC_DATA.md). The published pages of tiers A, B and C and the children's texts of every tier are too many for the catalogue seed: they are cut into shards of about 500 targets per language, and the service imports each shard into its `target_texts` table (one row per entry, the entry stored whole). `page` holds what GET /v1/targets/{id} answers for a published page in that language, less the two fields derived from it: the sections, the sources and the note are stored, `story` and `storyParagraphs` are not (they repeated the sections, three times the text; a reader derives them with the rule of the `target-page-story` conformance fixture, docs/STATIC_DATA.md); `lede` is the title and the first sentence(s) of the page, about 200 bytes, for lists that do not open the page; `children` is the children's text, read aloud (`childrenSpokenParagraphs` of the route). An entry of tier A carries its page like one of tier B or C (additive: the page left the catalogue seed for the shards); a tier A entry with `children` only is the older form, still valid, and a reader whose target has no page entry for a language keeps the page the catalogue seed still serves. `entries` are sorted by `id`; `revision` of an entry is a digest of its content (an unchanged target keeps it), `revision` of the shard a digest of its entries' revisions.

section.description: An intertitle (null for the opening lede) and its paragraphs.

page.description: The stored page fields of GET /v1/targets/{id}, for the language of the shard: `storySections` the page cut by intertitle (the opening lede first, under a null heading), `researchSources` the links the page cites in its own words, `researchNote` the closing note on their licences. `story` and `storyParagraphs` of the route are not stored: `storyParagraphs` is the paragraphs of every section in order, intertitles excluded, and `story` is those paragraphs joined by a single space (portal/target-page-story.js; fixture packages/astro-contracts/fixtures/spec/target-page-story.json).

entry.description: One target in one language. Tiers A, B and C: the whole page, with its lede, and the children's text when the target has one (tier A used to carry this in the catalogue seed). Older tier A form: the children's text alone, the page staying in the seed.

id.description: The catalogue identifier of the target.
The catalogue identifier of the target.

shard.description: The shard's number, on three digits; the file is `<locale>/<shard>.json`.
